# Camouflare 2.1.0

Camouflare 2.1.0 separates target failures from service failures: an unreachable target
returns the new `TARGET_UNREACHABLE` code, and a target error status with an empty body is
reported like any other upstream status. Logs now name the cause of request errors and
browser close failures.

## Added

- `TARGET_UNREACHABLE` for browser navigations that get no response from the target: DNS
  failure, connection refused or reset, and interrupted or partial transfer. A GET is
  retryable. Proxy failures are not included.
- Error completion logs carry `error_message`, the first line of the response message,
  at most 300 characters, redacted like every other field.

## Changes

- Docker Hub `latest` points at a release only when it is the newest
  `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` tag. Version tags stay immutable; GHCR keeps exact version tags only.
- At `LOG_LEVEL=INFO` and above, the captcha solver's per-request prepare/cleanup lines are
  suppressed. `DEBUG` keeps them; challenge-solving progress and warnings are unchanged.

## Fixes

- A target 4xx/5xx with an empty body, which Firefox refuses to render, returns
  `status: "ok"` with the upstream status in `solution.status` and an empty
  `solution.response`. It was `INTERNAL_ERROR` with a traceback.
- `Failed to close browser.` logs the retire reason, exception type, and traceback. Failures
  whose message is empty, such as a cancellation, were logged with no cause.

## Client contract

No request field, response field, command, or configuration option is removed. Two
responses change for GET:

| Target behavior | 2.0.2 | 2.1.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4xx/5xx with an empty body | HTTP 500, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `retryable: false` | HTTP 200, `status: "ok"`, `solution.status` = target status, empty `solution.response` |
| DNS failure, refused, reset, interrupted transfer | HTTP 500, `INTERNAL_ERROR`, `retryable: false` | HTTP 500, `TARGET_UNREACHABLE`, `retryable: true` |

Clients must check `solution.status` on `status: "ok"`; a client that treats every
`status: "ok"` as a usable page now sees an empty page for these responses. Clients that
honor `retryable` retry unreachable targets. Prometheus v1 error metrics gain the
`TARGET_UNREACHABLE` label value, and `INTERNAL_ERROR` counts drop accordingly. Log
searches for `Failed to close browser (<reason>)` must match `Failed to close browser.` and
its `retire_reason` field instead.

The Events backend already rejects non-2xx `solution.status` values and honors
`retryable`, so it needs no change: empty error statuses become failed fetches (Biletino's
removed-event 404 becomes its terminal answer), and unreachable targets are released with
backoff like navigation timeouts.

## Deployment

Deploy the published index digest, not a floating tag, and keep the recorded 2.0.2 digest
for rollback. After deployment, check authenticated readiness and a representative
successful request, an empty-bodied target error status, and an unreachable target.
Published workflow, commit, index digest, and platform digests are recorded in
`docs/releases.md` after successful publication.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/mehmetcansahin/camouflare/blob/v2.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#210---2026-10-20)
for the complete entry.
